_comment: TASK-2 AC#7 conformance reference vectors for the A2A task-lifecycle types. Each vector is the EXACT JSON a meshy-a2a type serializes to. Two independent checks bind meshy to the spec: (1) the meshy-a2a Rust test crates/meshy-a2a/tests/conformance.rs asserts meshy reproduces each vector byte-for-byte, and (2) a2a_lifecycle_verify.py parses each vector through the REFERENCE A2A v1.0 ProtoJSON parser (a2a.types.a2a_pb2 + google.protobuf.json_format). meshy -> these vectors -> the reference proto = an independent anchor: a meshy drift breaks (1); a vector drifting off-spec breaks (2). This is the lifecycle-type companion to the TASK-7 Agent-Card oracle (a2a_card_verify.py).

provenance.source_of_record: github.com/a2aproject/A2A specification/a2a.proto @ tag v1.0.1 (package lf.a2a.v1, proto3)
provenance.note: v1.0 made ProtoJSON the single canonical JSON encoding for all bindings (JSON-RPC, gRPC, HTTP+JSON). Enum values are the proto names (TASK_STATE_*, ROLE_*), NOT v0.3.x kebab-case. Field names are camelCase (spec 5.5). No 'kind' discriminator. Source: whats-new-v1.md.
